scripts.build: node scripts/generate-stats.js && tsc --project tsconfig.v2.json && vite build && npm run postbuild
scripts.postbuild: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.cpSync('v1', 'dist/v1', {recursive: true}); fs.cpSync('labs', 'dist/labs', {recursive: true}); fs.cpSync('assets', 'dist/assets', {recursive: true, force: true}); fs.cpSync('showcase/media', 'dist/showcase/media', {recursive: true, force: true}); fs.copyFileSync('showcase/stats.json', 'dist/showcase/stats.json'); fs.copyFileSync('favicon.ico', 'dist/favicon.ico'); fs.copyFileSync('site.webmanifest', 'dist/site.webmanifest');"
scripts.validate: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run lint:md && npm run test
